title: Personal Care
summary: Daily hygiene, grooming, dressing and mobility assistance tailored to your needs.
how: We meet you, learn your preferences and routines, then match a support worker and agree a care plan reviewed regularly.

title: Community Participation
eligibility: Core or Capacity Building funding for community access
summary: Support to engage in social, recreational and community activities you love.
benefits: Access to local activities and groups
how: We identify activities that interest you, plan safe transport and support, then join you or arrange a support worker.

title: In-Home Support
eligibility: Core Supports funding for household tasks/home care
summary: Professional care in the comfort of your own home, on your schedule.
how: We assess your home environment and needs, then schedule regular visits from a consistent support worker.

title: Support Coordination
summary: Expert help to manage your NDIS plan and connect with the right services.
how: We review your plan and goals, connect you to suitable providers, and check in regularly on progress.

title: Transport Support
eligibility: Transport or Core funding in plan
summary: Safe, reliable transport to appointments, activities and community programs.
how: We discuss destinations and mobility requirements then schedule safe, punctual transport.

title: Capacity Building
summary: Programs to build your skills, confidence and independence.
how: We work with you to set goals, design a skill-building program, and track progress over time.
